title: On the Soul, to Tatian
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Vossius 1684 Opera omnia Latin column (Disputatio de Anima ad Tatianum); tip densify preface + inquiry program; Greek column OCR damaged
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, On the Soul to Tatian — tip densify of the preface and inquiry program from the 1684 Latin column. New English for private study; ANF 6 Salmond exists. Authenticity disputed in modern scholarship; attribution disclosed.
era_note: The Disputatio de Anima ad Tatianum stands under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name in the third-century Neocaesarean tradition; later Latin presentation and disputed authenticity are disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Salmond, PD); this is a new rendering from locked Latin for the tipped preface.

text_history.method: English densified from locked Vossius 1684 Latin column for tip preface + program; Greek column OCR too damaged to lock; scholia stripped; ANF 6 consulted only as sense check; earlier scaffold paraphrase discarded.

joins.note: Long-s and column joins expanded from the Latin face; sense checked against the inquiry program that follows.
